items.headline: 央行：无意靠人民币贬值争取贸易优势
items.headline_en: PBOC rules out seeking a trade edge through depreciation
items.summary: 央行副行长陆磊表示，中国将继续实行有管理的浮动汇率制度，由市场决定汇率，同时防范羊群效应和非理性预期。
items.summary_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said China would retain a managed floating exchange-rate regime, let markets play the decisive role and guard against herd behaviour.

source.name: 国务院新闻办公室 / SCIO

items.headline: 日本8月外汇储备减少795.75亿美元
items.headline_en: Japan's reserves fall by $79.6 billion in August
items.summary: 日本财务省公布，8月底外汇储备为1.2075万亿美元，较7月底减少795.75亿美元；其中证券资产降至8395.59亿美元。
items.summary_en: Japan's reserves stood at $1.2075 trillion at the end of August, down $79.6 billion from July. Securities holdings fell to $839.6 billion.

source.name: 日本财务省 / Japan Ministry of Finance

items.headline: OpenAI公布纳维—斯托克斯证明稿
items.headline_en: OpenAI publishes a proposed Navier-Stokes proof
items.summary: OpenAI称内部模型构造出有限时间奇点，并公开论文和Lean形式化版本。该结果仍待数学界独立审查，尚不能视为正式获奖解答。
items.summary_en: OpenAI says an internal model constructed a finite-time singularity and released a paper with a Lean formalisation. Independent mathematical review is still needed.

items.headline: PISA：OECD阅读和数学平均分创新低
items.headline_en: OECD reading and maths scores hit record lows
items.summary: PISA 2025覆盖91个国家和经济体、76万名15岁学生。OECD平均阅读分比2022年低14分，数学低9分；科学成绩总体持平。
items.summary_en: PISA 2025 assessed 760,000 students in 91 countries and economies. Across the OECD, reading fell 14 points and mathematics 9 since 2022, while science was broadly stable.

source.name: 经济合作与发展组织 / OECD

items.headline: 青岛货轮检修火灾造成25人死亡
items.headline_en: Qingdao ship fire kills 25 during maintenance
items.summary: 9月10日，一艘外籍货船在青岛北海造船检修时起火。船上42人中，12人撤离、5人受伤，另有25人死亡。事故原因尚未公布。
items.summary_en: A foreign cargo ship caught fire during maintenance at Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding on 10 September. Of 42 people aboard, 25 died, five were injured and 12 escaped.

items.headline: 阿尔及利亚宣布与阿联酋断交
items.headline_en: Algeria cuts diplomatic ties with the UAE
items.summary: 阿尔及利亚外交部9月10日宣布，即日起与阿联酋断绝外交关系，并已通知阿联酋驻阿大使，要求其在48小时内遵守这一决定。
items.summary_en: Algeria announced on 10 September that it was cutting diplomatic ties with the UAE and gave the Emirati ambassador 48 hours to comply with the decision.

previous_answers.headline:
六个人中，为什么一定能找到三位熟人，
或三位互不认识的人？
previous_answers.headline_en: Why must six people contain three mutual acquaintances or three mutual strangers?
previous_answers.explanation:
任选一人 A。其余五人中，至少有三人都认识 A，或至少有三人都不认识 A。

若 A 认识 B、C、D，其中任何两人认识，就与 A 组成三位熟人；若三人之间无人相识，B、C、D 就是三位陌生人。若 A 不认识 B、C、D，其中有两人互不认识，他们与 A 组成三位陌生人；否则 B、C、D 彼此认识。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Choose any person A. Among the other five, at least three all know A, or at least three all do not.

If A knows B, C and D, a connected pair among them gives three mutual acquaintances with A. If there is no such pair, B, C and D are mutual strangers. If A knows none of them, an unconnected pair gives three mutual strangers with A; otherwise B, C and D all know one another.
previous_answers.subject: 上周证明题

previous_answers.headline:
单位长绳随机剪两刀，
三段能围成三角形的概率是多少？
previous_answers.headline_en: A unit string is cut at two random points. What is the probability that the three pieces form a triangle?
previous_answers.explanation:
设两刀位置为 0 < x < y < 1，三段长度为 x、y - x、1 - y。三段能成三角形，当且仅当每段都小于 1/2。

所有 (x, y) 构成面积为 1/2 的三角形。满足 x < 1/2、y > 1/2、y < x + 1/2 的区域面积为 1/8。因此概率为 (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Let the cuts be 0 < x < y < 1. The pieces have lengths x, y - x and 1 - y. They form a triangle exactly when every piece is shorter than 1/2.

All possible pairs (x, y) fill a triangle of area 1/2. The region satisfying x < 1/2, y > 1/2 and y < x + 1/2 has area 1/8. The probability is therefore (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4.
previous_answers.subject: 上周概率题

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上周思考题 · 示例估算 / LAST WEEK · SAMPLE ESTIMATE
previous_answers.headline:
北滘镇一个工作日，
大约会有多少单外卖？
previous_answers.headline_en: Roughly how many food-delivery orders are placed in Beijiao on a weekday?
previous_answers.result: 约 5 万单 / 工作日
previous_answers.explanation:
一组假设：北滘工作日常住及通勤人口约25万，其中60%会用外卖；这部分人平均每周点2单，按5个工作日均摊。

25万 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 6万单。再用约1800名活跃骑手、每人每天25单核对，得到4.5万单。因此可估为约5万单，合理范围是4万到6万单。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
One set of assumptions: about 250,000 residents and commuters are in Beijiao on a weekday; 60% use food delivery and place two orders per working week. This gives 250,000 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 60,000 orders.

A cross-check using 1,800 active riders at 25 orders each gives 45,000. A reasonable estimate is therefore about 50,000, with a range of 40,000 to 60,000.
